title: Faith Christian Center International - Connect Groups

segments.text: Our Connect Groups are for everyone! They are the core of Faith Christian Center because this is where we connect people to the Bible and other believers. It is an opportunity for us to do life together and build close relationships with people who share similar interests in small, safe, positive environments. There is bound to be group for you!
There are three things you should know about our connect groups:

1. They are “Free market” groups. Our groups are as varied as we are. Group facilitators use their gifts and passions to create a group that allows others to join with them in serving God. Whatever the age, interest, or location there is a group that is just right for you.
2. We have three semesters every year. New groups start and stop three times a year - spring, summer, and fall semesters. Each semester is kicked off with sign-ups and a new connect group directory.

3. Any partner can facilitate a group. We believe that everyone has areas of strength and gifting that could benefit others. The first step in becoming a connect group facilitator is to attend the Connect Group Facilitator Orientation. This class is offered throughout the year to give you an overview of what it takes to start a group. You’ll discover that it’s easier than you think.
2025 Spring Semester Connect Group Opportunities
COOKING GROUP
May 2nd, May 16th, May 24th & June 13th

Healthy Bites, Longer Life: Cooking for a Better You" is a transformative cooking class designed for individuals looking to improve their health through delicious, nutrient-rich meals. You'll learn how to prepare dishes that improve overall health, all while enjoying the process of cooking. Group size is limited.
Note: Each participant is responsible for food cost. Approx. $15 per session

DANCE-FIT GROUP
Sunday afternoons starting on April 27th

Are you ready to get moving and have a blast Whether you're a seasoned dancer or a curious beginner, we welcome all fitness levels to join in the fun and fellowship. Step out with us with dynamic dance moves tailored to uplift your spirit and energize your body. It’s not just about fitness—it’s a celebration of life, health, and community!
Bring your water bottle, a towel, and your enthusiasm. Most importantly, bring yourself, just the way you are! Invite your friends, and let’s make this a time to look forward to.
Learn More
DATE YOUR MATE GROUP
April 26th, May 17th, May 31st & June 7th

The Vows & Vibes Date Night Group will provide opportunities for you to embark on delightful adventures with your spouse where each date is designed to bring you closer and deepen your connection. Through fun activities and shared experiences, you'll not only nurture your relationship but also form lasting friendships with other couples.
Whether you’re newlyweds or celebrating decades together, this group is perfect for you! Bring an open heart and your spouses hand, ready to explore and cherish the sacred bond of marriage.
Learn More
WALKING GROUP
Sundays @ 1:30 PM beginning on April 27th
Walking can be a powerful tool for improving your health, boosting your mood, and more! Why not do it together?

Embark on a refreshing journey through scenic neighborhood routes, where every step is a chance to revitalize your body, clear your mind, and strengthen community ties. This is more than just a walk; it’s an opportunity to enjoy the beauty of nature while invigorating your spirit.
All are welcome—wear comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle, and your positive spirit! Whether you’re a brisk walker or prefer a leisurely pace, there’s a place for you in our group.
